title: תְּפִלָּה לַעֲצֵי הַיַּעַר עַל ט״וּ בִּשְׁבָט | Prayer for the Trees of the Forest on Tu biShvat, by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer
author: Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

coauthors.name: Isaac Gantwerk Mayer
coauthors.bio: From a family of musicians, Isaac Gantwerk Mayer believes that creative art is one of the most powerful ways to get in touch with the divine. He composes music and poetry in Hebrew and English. (He also translates and transcribes Hebrew and Aramaic texts, adding niqqud and t'amim as needed.) Isaac runs a Jewish music transcription service, which will transcribe and set any Jewish music in any language, recorded or written. Contact his service on Facebook or via his music blog.

excerpt: A Tu biShvat prayer for the trees of the land of Israel and the world over, that they not be victims of deforestation.
content:
Source (Hebrew) Translation (English)
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ (וְאִמוֹתֵינוּ),
חַדֵּשׁ אֶת הַיְּעָרוֹת
בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל
וּבְכָל הָעוֹלָם.
Our God and God of our ancestors,
renew the forests
in the Land of Israel
and all the world.
וּשְׁמֹר אֶת הַעֵצִים בַּהֶם,
מְחַדְּשֵׁי הָאֲוִיר,
וְשׁוֹמְרֵי הַחַיִּים.
And guard the trees within them,
renewers of the air
and guardians of life.
וְהָאֵר אֶת לֵב הָאִישׁ
אֲשֶׁר חוֹתֵךְ אוֹתָם בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת
וּבְכָל אָרְצוֹת בָּעוֹלָם,
כַּכָּתּוּב: ”לֹא־תַשְׁחִ֤ית אֶת־עֵצָהּ֙
לִנְדֹּ֤חַ עָלָיו֙ גַּרְזֶ֔ן“ (דברים כ:יט),
And enlighten the mind
of those who would cut them down in this land
and in all the lands of the world,
as it is written, “You shall not cut down its trees
by wielding against them an axe.” (Deuteronomy 20:19)
וְגַם בְּדִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ כָּתּוּב:
”עֵץ־חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּֽחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ
וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר“ (משלי ג:יח).
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה הַמְּחַדֵּשׁ הַעֵצִים׃
And also, in the words of King Solomon it is written,
“A tree of life it is to those who hold fast to it,
and all its supporters are content.” (Proverbs 3:18)
Blessed are you, the renewer of the trees.
